newsitem.title: USA: Sharp ships wide-screen notebook PCs.
newsitem.headline: Sharp ships wide-screen notebook PCs.

text.p: Sharp Electronics Corp said it has begun shipping its WideNote computer line, the industry's first wide-screen format notebook computers.

Sharp said the 4.6-pound models offer a 16:9 ratio theater proportioned liquid crystol display with Intel Corp's Pentium 133 megahertz processor, a 28.8 fax modem a one gigabyte hard drive and 16 megabytes of EDO RAM.
The computers come in two versions, a WideNote W-100T with an active-matrix display expected to be priced around $3,000, and a dual-scan display version, the W-100D, expected to cost around $3,500.

Both models come equiped with the new integrated 4 megabit infrared port that is 35 times faster than earlier devices, along with a 28.8 modem for voice, data or fax and both Netscape Navigator and Microsoft Internet Explorer.
